title: Inflight Study of Cardiovascular Deconditioning
archive_status: Data preservation is complete. All datasets are publicly available.
notes: Downloaded: tabular files (xls/xlsx/csv/txt) and PDF reports up to 50 MB. Every Excel sheet is also saved as '<file>__<sheet>.csv' (raw cell grid, no header detection).
Not downloaded: figure images (tif/jpg) - they are rendered graphs; their URLs are listed under skipped_files.
Downloaded files are untrusted data: parse only, never open macros / execute.
IMPORTABLE (observation): files/178066__3141149154/...xlsx__Sheet1.csv - per-subject resting HR/BP/MAP/Q/SV/FRC, 6 subjects x 3 conditions.
No subject names; only 'Subject No' 1..6 (pooled STS-40 + STS-58 crews; the file does not say which subject flew on which mission). The header cell names the PI (Farhi, Leon), not a subject.
7 graph images (HR, MAP, Q, TPR, a-v O2 diff, triple product vs VO2) not downloaded - see skipped_files.

files/178066__3141149154/178066__3141149.what: Table 2 of Shykoff et al. J Appl Physiol 1996;81:26-32: average RESTING data by subject
files/178066__3141149154/178066__3141149.granularity: per subject (Subject No 1..6), one value per subject per condition
time_points: In flight (day not stated; STS-40 9 d, STS-58 14 d missions)
files/178066__3141149154/178066__3141149.layout: Rows 1-6 are title/legend; header split over 2 rows (units in the 2nd row: 'beats/min', 'BP, mmHg', 'mmHg', 'SV, ml', 'liters'); condition label rows ('Preflight erect' / 'In flight' / 'Preflight supine') with 6 subject rows under each; footer with abbreviations and source.
pitfalls: Header is split across two rows and cells contain commas/units - map by column position, not header text.
No dates or flight days; condition is the time point (pre vs in-flight). No postflight session.
Erect vs supine preflight are two different postures - store posture as an attribute, not as different time points.

files/178066__3141213517/178066__3141213.what: Table 3: regression slopes (mean +/- SE) of Q, MAP, RQ, HR, VE, VT vs VO2, normalized by resting value, for erect / flight / supine
pitfalls: Values, '±' and SE are in separate cells (value, '±', SE triples).
Normalized slopes, dimensionless; not a vital-sign value.

Source: Shykoff BE, Farhi LE, Olszowka AJ, Pendergast DR, Rokitka MA, Eisenhardt CG, and Morin RA. Cardiovascular response to submaximal exercise in sustained microgravity. Journal of Applied Physiology. 1996 July; 81(1):26-32.
